name: Chrome DevTools
purpose: Opens your app in Chrome and clicks, types, reads the console and network, and takes screenshots.
why: Your agent can see and drive the real page, the way you would.

name: Playwright
purpose: Drives a browser with Playwright: open pages, click, fill forms, read what's on screen.
why: Good for clicking through a flow end to end in any browser.

name: GitHub
purpose: Reads and writes issues, pull requests, code and checks on GitHub.
why: Your agent can look up an issue or a PR without you copying it over.

name: Postgres
purpose: Looks at your Postgres database: tables, columns and read-only queries.
why: Your agent can check what's really in the database when something looks wrong.

name: Supabase
purpose: Reads your Supabase project: tables, logs, edge functions and settings (read-only).
why: Your agent can see the database and logs behind your app.

fields.name: SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
fields.label: Project ref
fields.hint: The id in your project's URL on supabase.com

name: SQLite
purpose: Opens a SQLite database file and runs queries on it.
why: Your agent can look inside the app's database file.

fields.name: SQLITE_PATH
fields.label: Database file
fields.hint: A path inside this project, like data/app.db

name: Project files
purpose: Reads and searches files, limited to this project's folder.
why: Handy for agents outside Shrike; inside Shrike your agent already reads code.

name: Fetch
purpose: Reads a web page and turns it into plain text for your agent.
why: Your agent can read docs or an error page you link to.

name: Sentry
purpose: Reads your Sentry errors: what broke in production, how often, and the stack trace.
why: Your agent can start from the real error your users hit.

name: Linear
purpose: Reads and updates your Linear issues and projects.
why: Your agent can pick up the ticket and say what it did.

name: Figma
purpose: Reads the design you have selected in the Figma desktop app (turn on its Dev Mode MCP server first).
why: Your agent can match the screen to the design, spacing and colours included.

name: Stripe
purpose: Looks up Stripe customers, payments and products, and creates test data.
why: Your agent can check what Stripe really got. Use a test key.

fields.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
fields.label: Stripe test key
fields.hint: Starts with sk_test_. Never a live key

name: Context7 docs
purpose: Looks up current docs and examples for the libraries your app uses.
why: Your agent writes code against today's API, not last year's.

name: Memory
purpose: A small notebook your agent keeps between runs: people, decisions, facts.
why: Your agent remembers what it learned last time.
